title: Incident report: label roll feed direction
titleZh: 異常報告：標籤紙捲的進紙方向
passage:
Marl Bank Print Services | Incident report 26
On arrival, both cartons were undamaged. Two rejected rolls had the correct label wording but had been wound with the labels facing inward. On this printer, the sensor reads only the outward-facing side of the roll. The roll may still feed and print when loaded in the wrong direction, but it will not stop at the intended cut marks.
The first operator restarted the printer and got the same result. Then she drew a short pencil line across the exposed side of a rejected roll and watched it pass the sensor. The sensor found the pencil line but not the printed cut marks. This established that the sensor was responding; it did not establish that it could see the original marks. A control roll wound outward then stopped at all of its cut marks.
Stores is to separate suspect rolls by the direction shown on the end ticket, not by wording. A missing or unclear direction ticket means the roll goes to the rewinding bench for inspection. Once a roll has been checked there and wound outward if necessary, it can be returned to normal stock. Testing and the stock record must refer to the direction in which the roll was released, not the direction in which it arrived.
passageZh:
Marl Bank 印務服務｜異常報告 26
兩箱送達時外箱都完好。有兩卷遭退驗的標籤文字正確，但捲繞方向是標籤朝內。此印表機的感測器只能讀取標籤紙捲朝外的一面。捲向裝反時，紙捲可能仍會進紙及印刷，但機器不會在預定的裁切記號處停止。
第一位操作員重新啟動印表機，結果相同。她接著在問題紙捲露出的那一面畫一小道鉛筆線，觀察它經過感測器。感測器讀到了鉛筆線，卻沒讀到原先印好的裁切記號。這證明感測器有反應，但不能證明它能讀到原來的記號。接著，標籤朝外的對照紙捲在每個裁切記號處都順利停止。
倉庫應依紙捲端面標籤所列的捲繞方向區分有疑慮的紙捲，不應依標籤文字分類。若缺少捲向標籤或其內容不清楚，請將紙捲送到回捲工作台檢查。紙捲經檢查，並在需要時改捲為朝外後，就能放回正常庫存。測試及庫存紀錄應依放行時的捲向，而非收貨時的捲向。
